Caption: An abandoned Haussmannian bedroom with herringbone parquet, stained plaster cornices, marble fireplace and enormous antique trumeau mirror in an aged gilded frame. The mirror reflects the empty room correctly for now; dim amber lamp light mixes with icy blue spill through old shutters. No people, no apparitions.
